question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'compiled'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• disbursed - pay out (money from a fund).
 
• compiled - produce (a list or book) by assembling information collected from other sources.
 
• dispersed - distribute or spread over a wide area.
 
• captured - take into one's possession or control by force.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word which would indicate how the mentioned book was put together. 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that compiled is the appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - **Dance as an artistic form of (1) expression is extremely old. Evidence of dance as a (2) creative form is available in ancient literary texts, painting and sculpture. (3) Many of the dance forms trace their roots to the (4) techniques of movement codified in the Natya Shastra (5) compiled by Bharat Muni.*
